Sidebar

A sidebar provides persistent vertical navigation alongside main content, supporting links, icons, badges, and nested collapsible sections.

Toggleable Sidebar

Open and close a sidebar from a button using data-zak-sidebar-toggle="#target".

CSS Classes

Sidebar styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Sidebar Container */
.zak-sidebar                  /* Base sidebar */
.zak-sidebar-light            /* Light background */
.zak-sidebar-dark             /* Dark background */
.zak-sidebar-fixed            /* Fixed position */

/* Sidebar Parts */
.zak-sidebar-header           /* Top header area */
.zak-sidebar-nav              /* Navigation container */
.zak-sidebar-footer           /* Bottom footer area */

/* Links */
.zak-sidebar-link             /* Navigation link */
.zak-sidebar-link.active      /* Active state */

/* Sections */
.zak-sidebar-section          /* Collapsible section wrapper */
.zak-sidebar-section-header   /* Section header button */
.zak-sidebar-section-body     /* Section body container */
.zak-sidebar-section.collapsed /* Collapsed state */

/* Nested */
.zak-sidebar-subnav           /* Nested nav wrapper */
.zak-sidebar-subnav-toggle    /* Toggle button for nested */
.zak-sidebar-subnav-items     /* Nested items container */
.zak-sidebar-subnav.open      /* Nested items expanded */

JavaScript

Use JavaScript for collapsible sections and nested navigation toggles.

HTML
// Toggle collapsible sidebar sections
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-section-header').forEach(header => {
    header.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-sidebar-section').classList.toggle('docs-sidebar__category--collapsed');
    });
});

// Toggle nested subnav
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-subnav-toggle').forEach(toggle => {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-sidebar-subnav').classList.toggle('open');
    });
});

// Close other open subnavs
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-subnav-toggle').forEach(toggle => {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const subnav = this.closest('.zak-sidebar-subnav');
        const siblings = subnav.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-subnav.open');
        siblings.forEach(s => { if (s !== subnav) s.classList.remove('open'); });
    });
});

// Handle sidebar link clicks
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (!this.classList.contains('zak-sidebar-subnav-toggle')) {
            this.closest('.zak-sidebar-nav').querySelectorAll('.zak-sidebar-link').forEach(l => {
                l.classList.remove('active');
            });
            this.classList.add('active');
        }
    });
});

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using sidebars.

  • Use <aside> element with role="navigation" and an aria-label.
  • Mark the current page link with aria-current="page".
  • For collapsible sections, use aria-expanded on the toggle button.
  • Use aria-controls to associate the toggle with the expandable content.
  • Ensure keyboard navigation works through all sidebar links with Tab.
  • For icon-only sidebars, always provide title or aria-label attributes.
HTML
<aside class="zak-sidebar zak-sidebar-light" role="navigation" aria-label="Main sidebar">
    <nav class="zak-sidebar-nav">
        <a href="#" class="zak-sidebar-link active" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a>
        <a href="#" class="zak-sidebar-link">Projects</a>
    </nav>
</aside>

<!-- Collapsible section with ARIA -->
<div class="zak-sidebar-section">
    <button class="zak-sidebar-section-header" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="section-body-1">
        <span>Projects</span>
    </button>
    <div class="zak-sidebar-section-body" id="section-body-1" role="list">
        <a href="#" class="zak-sidebar-link" role="listitem">Website Redesign</a>
        <a href="#" class="zak-sidebar-link" role="listitem">Mobile App</a>
    </div>
</div>
